name: Streamarr
description: Stream Usenet content on demand through the Streamarr Core Server. Thin adapter — no download-to-disk.
overview: Surfaces the Streamarr Core Server's Usenet search results inside Jellyfin and makes them playable through Jellyfin's transcoding pipeline.
changelog: Add a PAR2 repair pipeline: when a needed article is definitively gone mid-stream, Core reconstructs the raw source/RAR bytes from the release's PAR2 set and resumes the open stream at the same offset instead of failing, with a Repairs page for live job status and admin control. Add two-phase playback admission (POST /api/v1/playback-sessions) so slow health/materialization/repair prepares no longer hold Jellyfin's global live-stream lock, with an in-player repair-status notification and a direct-resolve fallback for older Core versions. Add a Streaming History page recording completed playback sessions.
